audit.summary: Independent-noise posterior is incompatible with the deterministic reverse conditional used for core CDM and downstream training derivation. Released index coding omits required side information; its historical experimental effect is unresolved.
limitations: P1 — Incompatible conditional distributions in the core CDM derivation — Counterevidence: A shared-noise dependent coupling preserves the marginals and yields the deterministic update. Theorem B.3 coefficient conditions can be necessary marginal conditions, but do not identify the conditional.
